_about: Q&A answer hypotheses, read off the video frames by hand. Input to: aic run --answers.
Until a VQA model exists (CONSTRAINTS G5) this file is the only thing that can make the
answer axis of a Q&A row score at all.
Several phrasings per query on purpose: the result specification says the answer is compared
semantically in one place and as an exact string in another, so the safe play is to spend a
few slots on the plausible spellings of the same answer (docs/SUBMISSION.md 4.3).
